title: Joshua Tree & Palm Springs
subtitle: San Jose to the desert and back in four days, no LA, by Tesla
note: Four days that never touch Los Angeles. Out on I-5 and CA-58 over Tehachapi Pass, then CA-247 into the high desert. A full day in Joshua Tree National Park, two nights in Palm Springs, and home Sunday on CA-99 up the Central Valley. Planned for a Model Y with about 230 miles of range at 80%. Pins are approximate; tap Drive here for turn-by-turn.

stops.name: San Jose
stops.note: Leave around 9 AM with a full charge.

stops.name: Kettleman City Supercharger
stops.note: Big site off I-5, but it gets long lines on holiday weekends.

stops.name: Tehachapi Supercharger
stops.note: Top up before the high desert. CA-58 climbs over Tehachapi Pass.

stops.name: Barstow Supercharger
stops.note: Charge well here: CA-247 to Yucca Valley is about 80 miles of two-lane desert road with no services.

stops.name: Yucca Valley Supercharger
stops.note: Charge to about 90% tonight. There are no chargers inside Joshua Tree National Park.

stops.name: Joshua Tree
stops.note: Overnight in the town of Joshua Tree, a few minutes from the park's west entrance.

stops.name: Hidden Valley
stops.q: Hidden Valley Trailhead, Joshua Tree National Park
stops.note: Easy one-mile loop through a rock-walled valley. Get here early: parking fills fast on holiday weekends.

stops.name: Keys View
stops.q: Keys View, Joshua Tree National Park
stops.note: Lookout over the Coachella Valley, the San Andreas Fault and the Salton Sea. Clearest before midday.

stops.name: Skull Rock
stops.q: Skull Rock, Joshua Tree National Park
stops.note: The famous skull-shaped boulder right by the road.

stops.name: Arch Rock
stops.q: Arch Rock Trailhead, Joshua Tree National Park
stops.note: Short, flat walk from White Tank to a natural granite arch.

stops.name: Cholla Cactus Garden
stops.q: Cholla Cactus Garden, Joshua Tree National Park
stops.note: A quarter-mile path through a dense field of cholla. Look, don't touch: the spines stick.

stops.name: Palm Springs
stops.note: Two nights here. Charge at the Palm Springs Supercharger Saturday night before the drive home.

stops.name: Indian Canyons
stops.note: Palm Canyon's oasis of fan palms on Agua Caliente tribal land. Easy trails. Check the hours and entry fee before you go.

stops.name: Palm Canyon Drive
stops.q: Palm Canyon Drive, Palm Springs, CA
stops.note: Downtown Palm Springs: mid-century buildings, shops and lunch.

stops.name: Palm Springs Aerial Tramway
stops.q: Palm Springs Aerial Tramway, Palm Springs, CA
stops.note: Rotating cable car up to about 8,500 feet on Mount San Jacinto. Great at sunset. Check the last ride up before you go.

stops.name: Palm Springs Supercharger
stops.note: Charge to about 90% tonight: Sunday's first leg to Barstow is about 115 miles with a climb out of the desert.

stops.name: Fresno Supercharger
stops.note: Charge to about 90% here for the last 160 miles home on CA-99 and CA-152.

stops.name: San Jose
stops.note: Home Sunday night.

stops.name: Barker Dam
stops.q: Barker Dam Trailhead, Joshua Tree National Park
stops.note: Easy 1.3-mile loop to an old cattle dam, with petroglyphs near the end. Right next to Hidden Valley.

stops.name: Cottonwood Visitor Center
stops.q: Cottonwood Visitor Center, Joshua Tree National Park
stops.note: South exit of the park, where the high Mojave drops into the low Colorado Desert. Restrooms and water.

days.title: San Jose to Joshua Tree
days.note: I-5 to Kettleman City, CA-58 over Tehachapi Pass to Barstow, then CA-247 through Lucerne Valley into the high desert. No Los Angeles.
days.warn: You'll reach the desert after dark. CA-247 is a two-lane road with no lights or services, so take it steady.

days.title: A full day in Joshua Tree, then Palm Springs
days.note: Enter at the west entrance by 8 AM. Hike Hidden Valley and Barker Dam, see Keys View while the air is clear, then work east past Skull Rock and Arch Rock to the Cholla Cactus Garden. Leave by the south entrance at Cottonwood and take I-10 to Palm Springs for the evening.
days.warn: There are no chargers or gas inside the park, and lines at the west entrance get long on holiday weekends. Start the day near full and bring water and food.

days.title: A full day in Palm Springs
days.note: No long drive today. Palm Canyon in the morning, downtown for lunch, and the Aerial Tramway up Mount San Jacinto for sunset.

days.title: Palm Springs to San Jose
days.time: about 8.5 h driving + 1.5 to 2 h charging
days.note: Back the way you came through the high desert to Barstow and Tehachapi, then north on CA-99 through Bakersfield and Fresno instead of I-5. Still no Los Angeles.
days.warn: The Sunday after Thanksgiving is one of the busiest driving days of the year, and rain is possible in Northern California. Leave Palm Springs by 7 AM and expect lines at the Superchargers.
